title: Heartwarming Birthday Tradition Brings 5-Year-Old Boy to Tears
text:
A viral video captures the emotional reaction of a 5-year-old boy as his family shares what they love about him while placing candles on his birthday cake in San Diego.
One by one, family members share what they love about the birthday honoree as they place a candle on the cake. A family’s touching birthday tradition brought a 5-year-old boy to tears in a heartwarming video that went viral on social media.
Jonathan Gonzalez reports for the NBC4 News at 6 p.m. on Wednesday, Sept. 2, 2026. The glow of a birthday cake’s candles showed a 5-year-old boy’s eyes glistening while fighting back tears as one by one, his family members shared with the birthday boy what they love about him as part of their heartwarming tradition. Matias Gates’ touching reaction to the sweet tradition captured the hearts of Internet users as video of the birthday celebration reached millions of views.
The boy’s mother, Alexis Gate, said she’s intentional about letting her three children know how valued they are.
“It's one thing to let someone know their love, but it's something else to make them feel it,” the San Diego mother said. As part of the family’s new birthday tradition, each relative shares why they love the birthday honoree and then places a lit candle on the cake. The expressions included well wishes, hope for the young boy’s dreams to come true and blessings of many more birthdays to come.
Although they all ranged in uniqueness brought upon by individual family members, they were all filled with pure love.
“I just think, like having the support of all of our family there to pour that into him was so special and meaningful,” Alexis Gates said. Get Los Angeles's latest local news on crime, entertainment, weather, schools, cost of living and more. Here's your go-to source for today's LA news.
“When I watch it, it almost made me cry,” he said. “Because it's so special about my family. ”“It just brings tears to his eyes to this day and it's so cute,” she said.
“And I think it's very special to have those moments and be able to watch them over. ” The video flooded Alexis Gates’ post with hundreds of comments from Internet users who shared that it brought them to tears. The video also received much applause for the heartfelt tradition and some expressed that it inspired them to adopt the tradition themselves. It’s a feat that the Gates family has taken with honor.
“I hope to continue to possibly inspire people to speak to their kids that way and their family, and to be loved out loud, because it's truly beautiful,” Alexis said.
